   **Bugs and stability.**

      Review window: Jul 7, 2026 - Sep 18, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _hjgjkhfhgdsdfhgjklhfhdsrueytiu_, Sep 18, 2026, 1/5: "As a pro user for the last few years, it’s a shame to see Forest just keep going downhill - from adding AI slop trees, constant buggy updates, and now finally the new UI which makes returning to the home screen after planting a tree multiple clicks, I’m writing a review to hopefully get things to change. It’s a big shame, I hope they get their act together and remember what the core idea about the app is about."
            2. _Silk14789_, Sep 16, 2026, 1/5: "The developers have forced a buggy and fastidious update that ruins the app for me. It seems they went for sth “aesthetic” and forgot this a productivity app. At least give us the option to use the old UI back!"
            3. _Garv Malani_, Sep 14, 2026, 1/5: "the concept is excellent, helping me a lot, but the app is not that great. It feels very slow and every response is delayed. Hope you all will fix it soon"
